english.title: Permit use of motor vehicle - secondary coupling device on trailer not fitted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), drawing a trailer to which regulation 15 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 applied, when not fitted with a device designed to stop the trailer automatically in the event of the separation of the main coupling between the vehicle and trailer whilst the trailer was in motion
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 86A(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
